capabilities: Render Booklet notes as interactive multi-screen views
Present eight question kinds, quizzes and widgets
Write answers, drafts and entries into the note's records
Show dashboards with charts, tables and summaries
Author booklets visually in a Design view
disambiguation: Not a print-layout or pamphlet maker; 'Booklet' is a Markdown format for interactive forms, quizzes and courses.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.7 or later. The Design view is a beta and the Booklet format is still 0.x, so it may change. Format spec and docs live at bookletmd.org. Warns that some Linter plugin rules (e.g. ordered-list-style) can corrupt stored answers. Android and real-device screen readers are untested; the plugin has no telemetry or account.
problem: Obsidian notes are static Markdown with no native way to build interactive forms, quizzes or courses that collect and store a reader's answers.

relations.evidence: both open booklet notes, and only one should
stored the way the format and its reference renderer store them

summary: Renders Booklet-format notes as interactive views with questions, quizzes and dashboards, writing reader answers into the note's records section.
